national_news.title: BWF World Championships 2026: Indian Doubles Pairs Advance to Quarterfinals in New Delhi
bullets: Men's doubles duo Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty advanced to the quarterfinals of the BWF World Championships 2026 in New Delhi by defeating Malaysia's Junaidi Arif and Roy King Yap.
Women's doubles pair Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand reached the quarterfinals after defeating Japan's seventh seeds Rin Iwanaga and Kie Nakanishi in straight games.
PV Sindhu, Ayush Shetty, and the mixed doubles pair of Dhruv Kapila and Tanisha Crasto ended their tournament runs following pre-quarterfinal defeats.

national_news.title: Centre Unveils Delhi Master Plan 2047 for Sustainable Urban Growth
bullets: Union Government unveiled the Delhi Master Plan 2047, aligned with the 'Viksit Bharat 2047' vision, to transform the national capital into a world-class city for nearly 3.2 crore people.
The plan adopts dual planning approaches: area-based redevelopment (brownfield) focusing on Transit Oriented Development (TOD) and Right of Way-based planning for Greenfield areas.
Union Housing and Urban Affairs Minister Manohar Lal announced plans to add around 40 lakh new affordable housing units in the national capital over the coming years.

national_news.title: Sports Ministry Calls for Accelerated Talent Identification for 2036 Olympics
bullets: Union Minister for Youth Affairs and Sports Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya chaired the 63rd Governing Body Meeting of the Sports Authority of India (SAI).
Emphasized a comprehensive talent identification roadmap across schools, districts, and colleges to build India's athlete pool for the 2036 Olympics.
The Governing Body approved the establishment of the National Coach Accreditation Board to structure coach development.

national_news.title: 35th Manipuri Language Day Celebrated
bullets: The 35th Manipuri Language Day commemorates the inclusion of the Manipuri language in the Eighth Schedule of the Indian Constitution on 20th August 1992.
The event was organized by the Manipuri Language Day State Level Celebration Committee in collaboration with the Jawaharlal Nehru Manipur Dance Academy (JNMDA).
The State Government has announced efforts to secure 'Classical Language' status for Manipuri before the next annual celebration.

national_news.title: Supreme Court Forms Five-Member Panel to Investigate Student Protest Violence
bullets: The Supreme Court constituted a five-member High-Powered Enquiry Committee (HPEC) headed by former top court judge Justice R Subhash Reddy.
The panel will independently examine allegations of excessive police force and violence by protesters during nationwide student demonstrations.
The HPEC has been directed to submit periodic interim reports, prioritizing targeted violence and harassment of female protesters.

national_news.title: Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand Reach BWF World Championships Quarterfinals
bullets: Indian women's doubles badminton pair Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand reached the quarterfinals of the BWF World Championships in New Delhi.
The duo defeated seventh seeds Rin Iwanaga and Kie Nakanishi of Japan in straight games (21-16, 21-12).
Other top Indian shuttlers including P.V. Sindhu and Satwiksairaj Rankireddy-Chirag Shetty featured in subsequent rounds of the tournament.

national_news.title: 35th Manipuri Language Day Celebrated Across Manipur
bullets: The 35th Manipuri Language Day was celebrated to commemorate the inclusion of the Manipuri language in the Eighth Schedule of the Constitution of India on August 20, 1992.
The state-level event was held at the Jawaharlal Nehru Manipur Dance Academy (JNMDA) in Imphal under the theme 'State Song ‘Sana Leibak Manipur’ for Peace, Unity and Integrity'.
State Home Minister Govindas Konthoujam announced that the government will make concerted efforts to secure Classical Language status for Manipuri before the next year's celebration.

national_news.title: Supreme Court Forms Five-Member Panel to Probe Student Protest Violence
bullets: Supreme Court constituted a five-member High-Powered Enquiry Committee headed by former top court judge Justice R Subhash Reddy.
The committee will independently examine allegations of violence during student demonstrations at Jantar Mantar and other locations.
The bench comprised Chief Justice of India Surya Kant, Justice Joymalya Bagchi, and Justice V Mohana.

national_news.title: Mansukh Mandaviya Calls for Accelerated Talent Identification for 2036 Olympics
bullets: Union Minister for Youth Affairs and Sports Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya chaired the 63rd Governing Body Meeting of the Sports Authority of India (SAI).
Emphasized a comprehensive sports talent hunt across schools, districts, and colleges to build India's athlete pool for the 2036 Olympics.
The Governing Body approved the establishment of the National Coach Accreditation Board for structured coach development.

national_news.title: Government Unveils Delhi Master Plan 2047 for Sustainable and Inclusive Growth
bullets: The Delhi Master Plan 2047 was unveiled to provide a long-term spatial, economic, and institutional framework aligned with the 'Viksit Bharat 2047' vision.
Aims to transform the national capital into a world-class, inclusive city for nearly 3.2 crore people, adding 30 to 40 lakh new residential flats over coming years.
Introduces a Transit Oriented Development (TOD) policy to strengthen the Public Transport Corridor and support vertical growth and pollution mitigation.

national_news.title: Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir Elected as Bangladesh's 23rd President
bullets: Veteran Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) leader Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir was elected as Bangladesh's 23rd President, securing 255 votes in the Jatiya Sangsad.
This marked the first time in 35 years that more than one candidate contested the Bangladeshi presidential election.
The election was necessitated following the resignation of former President Mohammed Shahabuddin on health grounds before completing his five-year term.

national_news.title: India and Japan Deepen Defence Technology Partnership and Sign Maritime Security MoA
bullets: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh and Japanese counterpart Shinjiro Koizumi co-chaired the India-Japan Defence Ministers Meeting in New Delhi.
Both nations signed a Memorandum of Arrangement (MoA) on Maritime Security Cooperation to protect Sea Lines of Communications and ensure a free and open Indo-Pacific.
The leaders reviewed bilateral exercises including Dharma Guardian, JIMEX, and upcoming exercises like Veer Guardian 26.

national_news.title: Vice-President C.P. Radhakrishnan Addresses LBSNAA Officer Trainees
bullets: Vice-President C.P. Radhakrishnan addressed the valedictory programme of Phase-II training for the 2024 batch of IAS officer trainees at LBSNAA, Mussoorie.
Emphasized that character, integrity, and ethical decision-making are the true foundations of public service.
Stressed the role of civil services as a vital link in grassroots policy implementation and serving society with the 'Nation First' spirit.

national_news.title: Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand Advance to BWF World Championships Quarterfinals
bullets: India’s women's doubles pair Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand reached the quarterfinals of the BWF World Championships held in New Delhi.
The Indian duo defeated seventh-seeded Japanese pair Rin Iwanaga and Kie Nakanishi in straight games (21-16, 21-12).
Other top Indian shuttlers including P.V. Sindhu, Ayush Shetty, and Satwiksairaj Rankireddy-Chirag Shetty featured in respective matches.

national_news.title: Nagaland Legislators Meet Union Minister Dr. Jitendra Singh to Discuss Infrastructure and Human-Elephant Conflict
bullets: A delegation of Wokha legislators led by Nagaland Deputy Chief Minister Yanthungo Patton met Union Minister of State for Science and Technology Dr. Jitendra Singh in New Delhi.
Discussions focused on upgrading regional connectivity, including proposals to declare the Wokha–Merapani road as a National Highway.
The delegation also sought a comprehensive policy response and special package to address recurring human-elephant conflicts in the Wokha district.

national_news.title: PIB Organizes 'Vartalap' Media Workshop in Chamoli to Enhance Welfare Scheme Awareness
bullets: The Press Information Bureau (PIB) Dehradun organized the 'Vartalap' Regional Media Workshop in the border district of Chamoli, Uttarakhand.
The workshop focused on improving last-mile awareness of Central and State government welfare schemes concerning health, agriculture, fisheries, and women empowerment.
Discussions also highlighted the Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyan, under which 140 narcotics kits were distributed in the district.

national_news.title: DG Eastern Zone Reviews Performance of PIB and CBC Regional Offices in Bhubaneswar
bullets: Director General (Eastern Zone) T.V.K. Reddy reviewed the outreach programmes and communication initiatives of PIB and CBC regional offices in Bhubaneswar.
The review emphasized the importance of direct interpersonal communication and field-level outreach to bridge communication gaps for flagship government schemes.
Officials from Doordarshan and All India Radio also participated to strengthen inter-agency synergy for public communication.

national_news.title: PIB Dehradun Hosts 'Vartalaap' Workshop in Gopeshwar to Bridge Government-Media Dialogue
bullets: PIB Dehradun organized the 'Vartalaap' regional media workshop in Gopeshwar, Chamoli, to strengthen dialogue between local media and the government.
The workshop marked 12 years of the Central Government's focus on public service, governance, and rural welfare.
Key topics discussed included the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana, Ayushman Bharat, E20 fuel, and One District One Product (ODOP) initiatives.

national_news.title: 2nd BRICS 2026 Tourism Working Group Meeting Held in Jaipur
bullets: The Ministry of Tourism hosted the 2nd BRICS 2026 Tourism Working Group (TWG) meeting in Jaipur, Rajasthan, under India's BRICS Chairship.
The meeting was chaired by Bhuvnesh Kumar, Secretary, Ministry of Tourism, and focused on the overarching theme 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'.

Discussions centered around India's four thematic priorities: Artificial Intelligence and Tourism, Sustainability and Responsible Tourism, Tourism Skilling and Capacity Building, and Seamless Travel Facilitation.

national_news.title: HM Amit Shah Chairs 31st Southern Zonal Council Meeting in Mahabalipuram
bullets: The 31st South Zonal Council Meeting was held in Mahabalipuram near Chennai, chaired by Union Home and Cooperation Minister Amit Shah.
Chief ministers, deputy chief ministers, and senior officials from southern states and union territories participated to discuss inter-state disputes, security, and development.
Discussions focused on internal security, economic growth, industrial investment, education, healthcare, and the implementation of Fast Track Special Courts (FTSCs) for speedy disposal of rape cases.

national_news.title: Fourth Round of India-Singapore Ministerial Roundtable Held in Singapore
bullets: The 4th round of the India-Singapore Ministerial Roundtable (ISMR) was held in Singapore to review ongoing initiatives and deepen bilateral ties.
Key Indian ministers participating included Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman, External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar, Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal, and MoS Jitin Prasada.
Discussions focused on advanced manufacturing, connectivity, digitalization, healthcare, skills development, and sustainability under the Comprehensive Strategic Partnership (CSP).

national_news.title: US President Donald Trump Announces Sweeping Economic Warfare Against Iran
bullets: US President Donald Trump announced a campaign of economic warfare and isolation against Iran over failed deal negotiations.
The measures target Iran's oil-smuggling networks, financial transfers, exchange houses, ship registries, and front companies.
The US administration warned third-party countries and financial institutions providing support to Tehran of severe economic consequences.

national_news.title: PIB Dehradun Organises 'Vartalaap' Media Workshop in Chamoli
bullets: The Press Information Bureau (PIB) Dehradun organized a regional media workshop named 'Vartalaap' in Gopeshwar, Chamoli.
The workshop aims to strengthen dialogue between local rural media and the government regarding welfare schemes and policies.
Discussions highlighted central initiatives including Ayushman Bharat, Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana, PM Matsya Sampada Yojana, and Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyan.

bihar_news.title: PMFME Scheme Drives Micro-Enterprise Growth in Bihar's Sheikhpura District
bullets: A local vendor in Sheikhpura district, Bihar, successfully established a micro-bakery enterprise and created local employment by leveraging credit assistance under the PMFME scheme.
The Pradhan Mantri Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME) Scheme was launched in 2020 under the Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan by the Ministry of Food Processing Industries.
PMFME is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme designed to address credit access, modern technology adoption, branding, and market linkage constraints faced by micro-food processing units in India.

bihar_news.title: Cabinet Approves Rs 13,041 Crore Rail and Highway Projects Across Five States
bullets: The Union Cabinet approved railway and highway projects worth over Rs 13,041 crore across West Bengal, Odisha, Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, and Bihar.

In Bihar, the Cabinet approved the four-laning of the 82.58-km Muzaffarpur-Sitamarhi-Sonbarsa section of National Highway-22 at an estimated cost of Rs 3,590.73 crore under the Hybrid Annuity Mode (HAM).
Four railway multitracking projects worth Rs 9,450 crore were approved to connect Chennai to Howrah, adding 410 km to the rail network across eight districts and targeted for completion by 2030-31.
